verdict.rationale: Kick documents AR as a Plus-plan feature and an invoicing workflow that shows synced invoices and lets users create and send invoices, so basic receivables tracking is the product's own capability. The aging and per-customer balance views it documents are for AP (bills and vendors), and that evidence cannot be credited to this AR story. Missing for 10: documented AR aging reports, per-customer receivable balances, AR report depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances

citations.quote: Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
View invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL, and create and send invoices directly from Kick.
